'''Janet Sue Fender''' is an American [[physicist]]. She is the Scientific Adviser to the Commander, Air Combat Command, Langley Air Force Base, Virginia, USA. She was president of the [[Optical Society of America]] in 1997.<ref>{{cite news|title=Past Presidents of the Optical Society of America |publisher=Optic Society of America |url=http://www.osa.org/aboutosa/leadership/pastpresidents/default.aspx |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20090120044158/http://osa.org/aboutosa/leadership/pastpresidents/default.aspx |archivedate=2009-01-20 }}</ref>

== Education ==
Fender was awarded a BSc in physics and astronomy by the [[University of Oklahoma]] in 1973.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.af.mil/About-Us/Biographies/Display/Article/107099/dr-janet-s-fender/|title=DR. JANET S. FENDER > U.S. Air Force > Biography Display|website=www.af.mil|access-date=2018-10-03}}</ref> She went on to gain a Masters and a PhD in optical sciences at the [[University of Arizona]].<ref name=":0" />

== Career ==
Following graduation from Arizona, Fender joined the [[Air Force Research Laboratory|Air Force Weapons Laboratory]] at [[Kirtland Air Force Base]], [[New Mexico]].<ref>{{Cite journal|date=December 1994|title=Fender will Lead Optical Society in 1997|journal=Physics Today|volume=47|issue=12|pages=57|doi=10.1063/1.2808746|issn=0031-9228}}</ref> She rose to become chief scientist for space vehicles and senior scientist for advanced imaging at the laboratory in 1997.<ref name=":0" /> In 2004 she was appointed scientific adviser to the commander at Air Combat Command, [[Langley Air Force Base]], [[Virginia]].<ref name=":0" />

== Awards ==

* [[Presidential Rank Awards|Presidential Distinguished Service Rank Award]] (2015)
* Fellow of the [[The Optical Society|Optical Society of America]] (1994)
* Fellow of the [[SPIE|International Society of Optical Engineers]] (1988)
* Distinguished Alumni, [[University of Oklahoma]] (2009)
* Distinguished Alumni, [[University of Arizona]]
* [[Sigma Pi Sigma]] (National Physics Honor Society)
* Gold, Silver, Bronze Corporate Cup athletic medals
* Air Force Scientific Achievement Award
* American Defense Preparedness Association Crozier Prize
* Coty Most Extraordinary American Woman of the Year
* New Mexico Federal Woman of the Year
* Who's Who Worldwide, Science and Engineering, Fourth Edition
* Coyote Classic Rally Navigator Award
* International Commission on Optics Awards
* Special Act Award, U.S. Air Force
